title: Answer: experience is representational content that meets certain constraints

statements.text: Experience is derived: it is the content of representations that meet constraints such as globality, presentationality and transparency, realized by brain states and supervening locally on them. It is real as phenomenal content. Only the self that seems to have the experience is an appearance.

sources.quote: what properties representations in a given information-processing system must possess in order to become phenomenal representations
It truly is a phenomenal property in terms of being an appearance only.
